examples.english: Dad bought meat from the butcher.
examples.transliteration: Baba eshtara la7ma men el gazzar.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: امي بتطبخ لحمة ورز حلو اوي
examples.english: My mother cooks very delicious meat and rice.
examples.transliteration: Omi betotbokh lahma we roz helw awi

examples.arabic: اخويا بياكل لحمة وبيضحك مع ابويا
examples.english: My brother is eating meat and laughing with my father.
examples.transliteration: akhouya biyakol lahma wa biyadhak maa abouya

examples.arabic: بس هو بياخد حته لحمه كبيره ويمشي
examples.english: But he takes a big piece of meat and leaves.
examples.transliteration: bas howa beyakhod hettet lahma kebeera we yemshey

examples.english: Mom made meat and rice today.
examples.transliteration: Mama amalet lahma we roz elnaharda

examples.arabic: هي عملت فنجان شاي وطبخت لحمة في حلتها
examples.english: She made a cup of tea and cooked meat in her pot.
examples.transliteration: heya aamalet fengan shay we tabakhet lahma fe haletha.
